author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Rabbi Abba, son of Rav Pappi: Shabbat, chapter 3, halakha 1. Avimi bar Pappi: Ketubot 53a.
Rav Huna, son of Rav Papi: Chullin 48; Nedarim 77a.
Rabbi Chiya bar Papi: Vayikra Rabbah 18:1.

notes.text: The list preserves Papi, Rav Papi and their named sons without assuming that every patronym refers to one father.
The supplied Chullin locator is מח followed by a comma, so the translation gives folio 48 without assigning a side.
